decisions.reason: Fouling detection automation was launched only in 2023, likely grew out of EU-funded research, and fits the firm's digital energy-recovery strategy; its value is still uncertain and carrying it within the existing automation offering costs little, so the option is worth keeping.

A web tool for weir dimensioning is cheap to maintain, supports the core flood-control business by drawing in engineering planners, and its value is not yet resolved, so keeping it is low-cost option value.

The fouling detection system overlaps with Product A and could be merged with it, which slightly raises the drop risk, but the early stage, unresolved uncertainty and modest hardware carrying cost still favor keeping it while market feedback accumulates.
